acceptanceCriteria: step_facts accepted with the requires fact syntax and bounds; variations differing only in step_facts group into one compatible set and are not duplicates; a key in both requires and step_facts refuses test-plan-invalid-input; TCN spec amended with new requirement IDs; tests cover each rule.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1320. `corvint test-plan consolidate` (TCN-V0-002/007) has one precondition channel, `requires`. A precondition the step installs and removes itself (stubbed 429/5xx/network error, mocked clock, viewport) either splits every variant into its own compatible set (`conflicting-state`; 2 of 3 retry-error variants in a 44-row adopter matrix), is left undeclared, or is smuggled into `action` as a fake element ID. Expected (issue proposal): optional `step_facts` with `requires` syntax and bounds; never a requires conflict or precedence edge; same key in both is `test-plan-invalid-input`; part of the TCN-V0-005 duplicate key; plan output unchanged apart from input_digest. Related limit in the same issue: `--map` and `--tests` share one --root/--revision, so split app/e2e repositories cannot validate anchors and decide reuse in one plan (consider --tests-root/--tests-revision recorded in the header) - track separately if not taken here.
title: test-plan consolidate: declare step-local preconditions (step_facts) so per-step stubs do not split compatible sets
